description: Whether holiday travellers need a visa or an electronic travel authorisation, for each passport and each destination country: the rule's name, the minimum processing days and its source (official government pages where available). Use it for visa and entry questions. Read only. Holiday entry only, not work, study or transit; rules change, so the traveller should check the official page before travelling.
name: check_entry_requirements

official.description: False when the rule comes from a public dataset, not an official page.

status.description: NONE: no visa for a holiday; NEEDED: a visa or authorisation; UNKNOWN: no confirmed rule.

title: Check visa and entry rules
